name: Chef Ayesha Rahman
bio: Chef Ayesha is known for modernizing traditional Bangladeshi dishes with a touch of global flavor. Her biryani and fusion kebabs are loved across Dhaka.

name: Chef Tanvir Ahmed
bio: Tanvir specializes in flame-grilled dishes and sauces. He’s known for his juicy steaks and creative plating techniques.

name: Chef Riya Chatterjee
bio: Riya brings French pastry art to local sweets. Her chocolate soufflé and mango mousse have become legendary among food bloggers.

name: Chef Imran Hossain
bio: Imran combines Japanese precision with Bangladeshi flavors. His sushi rolls and teriyaki platters are both artistic and delicious.

name: Chef Nabila Karim
bio: Nabila focuses on clean eating and plant-based nutrition. Her colorful bowls and smoothies make healthy food look irresistible.

name: Chef Arif Chowdhury
bio: Arif trained in Rome and brings authentic Italian flavors home. His handmade pasta and wood-fired pizzas are a crowd favorite.
